hunks.baseline: A breeze stirred my sweat-soaked hair, and I felt the new power and changes permeating my entire body.
hunks.sol: A breeze stirred my sweat-soaked hair, and I felt new strength and profound changes spreading through my entire body.

hunks.baseline: Even the clear bell that rang at the very end.
hunks.sol: Even the final, crystal-clear chime.

hunks.baseline: And I was not the only one who sensed these changes.
hunks.sol: And I wasn’t the only one who sensed the changes.

hunks.baseline: A master could not fail to know what his own hands had done. Realizing that his curse magic had been dispelled, the Arch Lich asked in a voice filled with disbelief,
hunks.sol: A master could hardly fail to notice what his own hand had done. Realizing that its curse magic had been broken, the Arch Lich asked in disbelief,

hunks.baseline: “How in the world?”
hunks.sol: “How?”

hunks.baseline: I shrugged at the single word that encompassed every question it had.
hunks.sol: I shrugged at the single word that contained every question it had.

hunks.baseline: “Well.”
hunks.sol: “Skillfully.”

hunks.baseline: “‘Well’?”
hunks.sol: “Skillfully?”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. Well.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. Skillfully.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course not. But why should I have to explain it to you?”
hunks.sol: “Of course not. But why should I explain it to you?”

hunks.baseline: The emotion of sheer incredulity came across clearly in the Arch Lich’s faintly trembling eye-lights.
hunks.sol: The faint tremor in the Arch Lich’s glowing eyes conveyed its sheer incredulity.

hunks.baseline: “I wanted to be one. Their allowances are higher. But I had no talent. I wasn’t smart, either.”
hunks.sol: “I wanted to be one. Mages get paid more. But I didn’t have the talent. I wasn’t smart enough, either.”

hunks.baseline: “Even those humans you call archmages could not dispel my magic so easily.”
hunks.sol: “Even the humans you call Grand Mages could not break my magic so easily.”

hunks.baseline: “They can’t. But it’s done.”
hunks.sol: “Well, I just did.”

hunks.baseline: Even I, who had already far surpassed the limits of an ordinary Hunter, had been unable to avoid its curse magic. And the large-scale illusion magic using Bone Spears had been truly dangerous.
hunks.sol: Even I, who had already far surpassed the limits of an ordinary Hunter, had been unable to avoid its curse magic. And its massive illusion spell using Bone Spears had been genuinely dangerous.

hunks.baseline: If I had not gained that insight, I might not even have been standing here now.
hunks.sol: If I hadn’t gained that insight, I might not even be standing here now.

hunks.baseline: I had the System, and I had merely done my best with the power and effort I had been given to overcome the crisis.
hunks.sol: I had the System, and I’d simply used the strength I’d been given and all the effort I’d put in to overcome the crisis.

hunks.baseline: If it felt so unfair, it could use the System, too.
hunks.sol: If it thought that was unfair, it could use the System, too.

hunks.baseline: “That’s how the world works. Even if it feels like shit and pisses you off, you just have to put up with it and move on. What else can you do? It’s already happened. Right?”
hunks.sol: “That’s just how the world works. Even if it feels like shit and pisses you off, you have to suck it up and move on. What else can you do? It’s already happened. Right?”

hunks.baseline: “Wow. You sure know how to phrase things nicely.”
hunks.sol: “Wow. You really have a way with words.”

hunks.baseline: I could be like that sometimes.
hunks.sol: That was just the kind of guy I was.

hunks.baseline: “But, devious human, that one does not appear to have any intention of simply putting up with it and moving on.”
hunks.sol: “But, devious human, that one does not appear willing to suck it up and move on.”

hunks.baseline: And at the same time—
hunks.sol: At the same time—

hunks.baseline: Highly compressed wind burst outward all at once.
hunks.sol: Highly compressed wind exploded outward all at once.

hunks.baseline: Just brushing against the sphere of wind fired at the speed of sound was enough to pulverize concrete and snap steel reinforcing bars.
hunks.sol: The sphere of wind shot forward at the speed of sound, pulverizing concrete and snapping steel rebar with the slightest touch.

hunks.baseline: The windows of the high-rise buildings, unable to withstand the aftershock, shattered one after another, and countless shards of glass were swept up in the wind.
hunks.sol: Every window in the high-rise buildings shattered under the aftershock, and countless shards of glass were swept into the gale.

hunks.baseline: In a single instant—before I could even blink—the enormous mass of wind had reached the tip of my nose.
hunks.sol: In a single instant—before I could even blink—the enormous mass of wind was right in front of me.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord’s scream, hurled from inside my inventory, echoed like a cry from far away.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord’s scream from inside my Inventory echoed like a cry from far away.

hunks.baseline: It didn’t matter. Whatever the real reason was, it made no difference.
hunks.sol: Whatever the real reason, it didn’t matter.

hunks.baseline: There was a world of difference between me a few minutes ago and me now.
hunks.sol: There was a world of difference between who I’d been a few minutes ago and who I was now.

hunks.baseline: The area around my chest grew hot.
hunks.sol: The center of my chest grew hot.

hunks.baseline: The spot martial artists called the Tanzhong acupoint, or the Middle Dantian, had opened wide.
hunks.sol: The place martial artists called the Tanzhong acupoint, or the Middle Dantian, had opened wide.

hunks.baseline: It allowed me to take in everything surrounding me, feel it against my skin, and see it with my eyes.
hunks.sol: It allowed me to take in everything around me—to feel it against my skin and see it with my own eyes.

hunks.baseline: The world slowed down, and everything became clear enough to see and understand.
hunks.sol: The world slowed, and everything became clear enough to see and understand.

hunks.baseline: The enormous sphere made of wind whipping like blades.
hunks.sol: The enormous sphere of wind, its currents whipping like blades.

hunks.baseline: And now, I could see that center.
hunks.sol: And now, I could see it.

hunks.baseline: The sphere of wind that looked as though it could sweep away everything in its path split in two along the blade of White Flame.
hunks.sol: The sphere of wind that looked ready to sweep away everything in its path split in two along White Flame’s spearhead.

hunks.baseline: The wind blades that had split from one enormous whole into hundreds and thousands broke free of the mana controlling them, scattering left and right and tearing through everything around them.
hunks.sol: The single enormous mass broke into hundreds—thousands—of wind blades. Freed from the mana controlling them, they veered left and right, tearing through everything around them.

hunks.baseline: A single stomp.
hunks.sol: One stomp.

hunks.baseline: The solid ground caved in, and I shot upward toward the ash-gray sky.
hunks.sol: The solid ground caved in, and I shot toward the ash-gray sky.

* * *
The instant Jin Taekyung shot up from the ground, the Arch Lich realized what it had to do.
hunks.sol: The instant Jin Taekyung launched himself from the ground, the Arch Lich realized what it had to do.

hunks.baseline: *I must not let that human approach.*
hunks.sol: *I must not let that human come any closer.*

hunks.baseline: Avoiding close combat was something every mage knew, but the meaning of it was different for the Arch Lich.
hunks.sol: Every mage knew to avoid close combat, but for the Arch Lich, those words carried a different weight.

hunks.baseline: *This body is feeling threatened by a mere human.*
hunks.sol: *This body feels threatened by a mere human.*

hunks.baseline: It prided itself on having already reached the pinnacle of dark magic.
hunks.sol: It prided itself on having reached the pinnacle of dark magic.

hunks.baseline: Although it had lost a considerable amount of power during the process of being resurrected as an Arch Lich, even now it possessed enough mana to regard archmages as beings a level beneath it.
hunks.sol: Although it had lost considerable power during its resurrection as an Arch Lich, even now it possessed enough mana to regard Grand Mages as beneath it.

hunks.baseline: Unlike before, the shout carried power. Invisible gravity pressed down over a radius of several dozen meters.
hunks.sol: Unlike before, the shout carried palpable power. Invisible gravity bore down over a radius of several dozen meters.

hunks.baseline: At the sight of Jin Taekyung racing through the air toward it, the Arch Lich’s eye-lights sank.
hunks.sol: The red glow in the Arch Lich’s eyes darkened as it watched Jin Taekyung race through the air toward it.

hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung had not only identified the precise range of its gravity magic but had also evaded it with some strange technique.

hunks.baseline: *As I thought. He did not dispel the illusion magic through mere luck. Then…*
hunks.sol: *As I thought. It was not mere luck that allowed him to break the illusion spell. In that case…*

hunks.baseline: Mana flowed from the Arch Lich’s entire body and shook the surrounding space.
hunks.sol: Mana poured from the Arch Lich’s entire body, shaking the surrounding space.

hunks.baseline: A high-level spell that even a fairly advanced mage would need to chant for quite some time poured out without pause.
hunks.sol: High-level spells that even a skilled high-ranking mage would have needed to chant at length came pouring out without pause.

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich was certain that this time, it could knock Jin Taekyung down.
hunks.sol: This time, the Arch Lich was certain it could knock Jin Taekyung from the sky.

hunks.baseline: *You, human. Fall.*
hunks.sol: *Fall, human.*

hunks.baseline: This time, it reduced the power of its gravity magic in exchange for expanding its range.
hunks.sol: This time, it reduced the strength of its gravity magic in exchange for expanding its range.

hunks.baseline: How could Jin Taekyung possibly evade gravity pressing down over a radius of several hundred meters—
hunks.sol: How could Jin Taekyung possibly escape gravity pressing down over a radius of several hundred meters—

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich’s eye-lights trembled.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the gravity magic pressing down on Jin Taekyung scattered, and the mana connected to the Arch Lich was severed like a thread.
hunks.sol: The gravity magic bearing down on Jin Taekyung dispersed, and the Arch Lich felt the mana connecting it to the spell snap like a thread.

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich froze for an instant at the fact that its magic had been dispelled.
hunks.sol: It froze for an instant, stunned that its magic had been broken.

hunks.baseline: With a sharp crack through the air, Jin Taekyung flew before the Arch Lich—no, a step above it—and swung White Flame downward.
hunks.sol: With a sharp crack through the air, Jin Taekyung hurtled in front of the Arch Lich—no, a step above it—and brought White Flame down.

hunks.baseline: A line of blue flame shot toward the Arch Lich.
hunks.sol: A line of blue flame streaked toward the Arch Lich.

hunks.baseline: In the slowed world, the invisible barrier surrounding the Arch Lich shattered into pieces.
hunks.sol: In the slowed world, the invisible barrier surrounding the Arch Lich shattered.

hunks.baseline: The flames of Force, fueled by three jiazi[^1] of Scorching Yang Qi, smashed through dozens of layered defensive spells and advanced toward the Arch Lich’s body.
hunks.sol: The flames of Force, fueled by three jiazi[^1] of Scorching Yang Qi, smashed through dozens of layered defensive spells and surged toward the Arch Lich’s body.

hunks.baseline: With an eerie cry, a wall made of black bones rose from the air.
hunks.sol: With an eerie cry, a wall of black bones rose into the air.

hunks.baseline: High above the ash-gray sky, an enormous shock wave and thunderous roar erupted around the two people facing each other with the bone wall between them.
hunks.sol: High in the ash-gray sky, an enormous shock wave and a thunderous roar erupted around the two figures facing each other across the bone wall.

hunks.baseline: Compressed wind burst outward.
hunks.sol: Compressed wind exploded outward.

hunks.baseline: The clouds circling far above scattered. Buildings that had barely maintained their shape collapsed, and half-rotted corpses were swept away by the wind.
hunks.sol: Clouds drifting high above scattered. Buildings that had barely remained standing collapsed, and half-rotted corpses were swept away by the blast.

hunks.baseline: Yet the two beings responsible for all those phenomena looked at each other beyond the barrier without so much as a tremor.
hunks.sol: Yet the two beings responsible for it all remained perfectly still, staring at each other through the barrier.

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich continued speaking as it stared at the transparent spearhead that had pierced through the center of the wall.
hunks.sol: The Arch Lich stared at the transparent spearhead piercing the center of the wall and continued,

hunks.baseline: The length of the spearhead that had passed through the bone barrier was no more than the width of a finger joint, but the Force that erupted in that instant had reached the tip of the Arch Lich’s nose.
hunks.sol: Only a finger joint’s length of the spearhead had penetrated the bone wall, but the Force that erupted from it had reached right before the Arch Lich’s face.

hunks.baseline: For the Arch Lich, it had been a fortunate escape.
hunks.sol: It had been a fortunate escape for the Arch Lich.

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich slowly continued speaking toward the bewildered Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: The Arch Lich slowly continued as Jin Taekyung stared at it in confusion.

hunks.baseline: “You have earned the right to be so arrogant. If you truly are the Adversary.”
hunks.sol: “You have earned the right to be. If you truly are the Adversary.”

hunks.baseline: “That is right. The king’s Adversary. An eternal nemesis bound to him by a god’s machinations. I cannot be certain yet, but… that must also be why I was able to rise again after stepping into the River of Death.”
hunks.sol: “That is right. The king’s Adversary. His eternal nemesis, bound to him by a god’s machinations. I cannot yet be certain, but… that must also be why I was able to rise again after stepping into the River of Death.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you suffering from middle-school syndrome? Get rid of those bones and show me your right hand. I want to see if you have a Black Flame Dragon.”
hunks.sol: “Do you have middle-school syndrome or something? Get rid of those bones and show me your right hand. Let’s see if there’s a Black Flame Dragon in there.”

hunks.baseline: “This is something that neither you nor I can understand. But one thing is certain.”
hunks.sol: “This is something neither you nor I can understand. But one thing is certain.”

hunks.baseline: The deeply sunken red eye-lights flared fiercely.
hunks.sol: Its deeply sunken red eyes flared fiercely.

hunks.baseline: But not anymore.
hunks.sol: Not anymore.

hunks.baseline: It recalled the memory of sweeping across this planet while serving the king decades ago.
hunks.sol: It remembered sweeping across this planet decades ago while serving the king.

hunks.baseline: It also recalled the figure of the human it had encountered on the day it lost everything and fell into the River of Death—the first and last time it had ever met that human.
hunks.sol: It also remembered the human it had encountered on the day it lost everything and fell into the River of Death—the first and last time it had ever seen him.

hunks.baseline: The human who had killed it and even assassinated the king.
hunks.sol: The human who had killed it and even slain the king.

hunks.baseline: The one it had tried to stop but could not, the one it had tried to approach but could not reach—the only human it had ever feared.
hunks.sol: The one it had tried to stop but could not, the one it had tried to approach but could never reach—the only human it had ever feared.

hunks.baseline: And today, in its battle with Jin Taekyung, the Arch Lich had remembered that day.
hunks.sol: And today, during its battle with Jin Taekyung, the Arch Lich had remembered that day.

hunks.baseline: “You… will definitely die here.”
hunks.sol: “You… will die here.”

hunks.baseline: The eerie voice that rang out was more resolute than ever.
hunks.sol: Its voice was eerie but more resolute than ever.

hunks.baseline: “Eat this, fucker.”
hunks.sol: “Eat this.”

hunks.baseline: Along with his low voice, a fist carrying blue hellfire shot forward, erasing everything that stood in its way.
hunks.sol: With those quiet words, a fist wreathed in blue hellfire shot forward, erasing everything in its path.

hunks.baseline: The bone barrier that looked as though it could block any attack collapsed.
hunks.sol: The bone barrier that had seemed capable of blocking any attack collapsed.

hunks.baseline: Beyond the countless fragments of bone scattering in every direction, the face of the Arch Lich came into view.
hunks.sol: Beyond the countless fragments of bone scattering in every direction, the Arch Lich’s face came into view.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung spoke with an expressionless face.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung stared at it expressionlessly.

hunks.baseline: “See? Isn’t this much better? My neck doesn’t hurt, either.”
hunks.sol: “See how much better this is? My neck doesn’t hurt, either.”

hunks.baseline: A single punch, fired like a ray of light, smashed into the Arch Lich’s jaw.
hunks.sol: A single punch, fired like a ray of light, slammed into the Arch Lich’s jaw.
